content:
**Marathoner** is an Agility-based perk in *Fallout 76*.

Decreased Action Points usage while sprinting.

| Rank | Cost | Description | Form ID | 
| ★★★ | 3 | Sprinting consumes 40% fewer Action Points. (No Power Armor) | 003701A8 | 
| ★★ | 2 | Sprinting consumes 30% fewer Action Points. (No Power Armor) | 002598E0 | 
| ★ | 1 | Sprinting consumes 20% fewer Action Points. (No Power Armor) | 0025989A | 

The perk has no effect while wearing power armor, as the Power Sprinter perk must be used instead.
